title: Table 3–9. Total Government Expenditure as Per Cent of GDP at Current Prices, Western Europe, the United States and Japan, 1913–1999
text:
Table 3–9. Total Government Expenditure as Per Cent of GDP at Current Prices, Western Europe, the United States and Japan, 1913–1999

| | 1913 | 1938 | 1950 | 1973 | 1999 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| France | 8.9 | 23.2 | 27.6 | 38.8 | 52.4 |
| Germany | 17.7 | 42.4 | 30.4 | 42.0 | 47.6 |
| Netherlands | a 8.2 | 21.7 | 26.8 | 45.5 | 43.8 |
| United Kingdom | 13.3 | 28.8 | 34.2 | 41.5 | 39.7 |
| Arithmetic Average | 12.0 | 29.0 | 29.8 | 42.0 | 45.9 |
| United States | 8.0 | 19.8 | 21.4 | 31.1 | 30.1 |
| Japan | 14.2 | 30.3 | 19.8 | 22.9 | 38.1 |

a) 1910. 
Source: 1913–73 from Maddison (1995a, p. 65); 1999 from OECD, Economic Outlook, December 1999, Table 28. 
The World Economy: A Millennial Perspective, Maddison (OECD, 2001), p.135.
